independence_statement: Saved before opening local spot, source, media or prior candidate records for these 25 names. Search/catalogue data selected candidates but did not establish acceptance.
method_limits: Coordinates are approximate discovery points and do not prove a launch.
Protected-area permission is unresolved unless an authority explicitly covers the sport and zone.
Image search returned no reviewable candidates because both providers failed; none is approved.
Full draft/cloud duplication access remained unavailable.

spots.name: Lancieux
spots.identity: Lancieux Bay public riding areas; exact launch changes with tide and seasonal beach use.
spots.conditions: Very large tidal range, exposed rocks and strong drift consequence; south wind is offshore.
spots.access_rules: Never ride alone in offshore wind; attach current summer beach restrictions and a tide-specific launch.
spots.trip_value: Broad multi-orientation bay and established nautical use justify worth_trip after launch/rule correction.

spots.name: Saint-Brevin – Les Rochelets
spots.identity: The designated Les Rochelets kite section at Saint-Brevin-les-Pins.
spots.conditions: Atlantic sandbanks provide flatter low-tide water or waves depending on wind and bank state.
spots.access_rules: Summer kite use is restricted to Rochelets and marked corridors; schools and bathers have priority.
spots.trip_value: A current official seasonal kite beach plus varied sandbank conditions support worth_trip.

spots.name: La Baule – K13
spots.identity: La Baule's K13 summer launch corridor, not the entire bathing bay.
spots.conditions: Large tidal bay with adequate wet-sand launch space only at suitable tide; crowded in summer.
spots.access_rules: Use K13 in summer, remain beyond the bathing area and follow the winter low-tide/coefficient rules.
spots.trip_value: Iconic bay and a defined advanced-rider corridor support worth_trip once the current ordinance is attached.

spots.name: Les Sables-d'Olonne – Tanchet
spots.identity: Tanchet beach and its established surf facilities south of the city centre.
spots.conditions: Atlantic beachbreak with changing banks; exact current/rip and level guidance must be locally maintained.
spots.access_rules: Respect supervised bathing sectors and school instructions.
spots.trip_value: Year-round schools, rental, city services and a named surf beach justify worth_trip.

spots.name: Pontaillac
spots.identity: Pontaillac's urban supervised beach in Royan.
spots.conditions: Small urban bay with seasonal supervision and variable swell exposure.
spots.access_rules: Surf follows bathing flags, supervision and municipal signage.
spots.trip_value: Good local access, but the evidence does not establish a dedicated-trip experience beyond nearby Atlantic alternatives.

spots.name: Hourtin Lake
spots.identity: Marked wind-sport sectors on Lac d'Hourtin-Carcans, outside the national reserve.
spots.conditions: Large freshwater lake with shallow sectors; wind and depth vary by launch.
spots.access_rules: Use marked buoy zones, remain outside reserve and swimming sectors, and attach the current municipal map.
spots.trip_value: Large lake, established zones and multi-discipline access support worth_trip after an exact launch is selected.

spots.name: Biscarrosse Plage
spots.identity: Biscarrosse's central ocean beachbreak, with peaks selected outside bathing sectors.
spots.conditions: Exposed shifting sandbanks, shorebreak and rips; west swell and easterly wind are commonly favourable.
spots.access_rules: Follow flags and lifeguard zones; conditions can exceed beginner level.
spots.trip_value: Reliable Atlantic surf identity, services and multiple banks support worth_trip.

spots.name: Gruissan – Plage des Chalets
spots.identity: Gruissan wind-sport coast around Plage des Chalets and its event corridors.
spots.conditions: Strong Tramontane can be offshore and extreme; exact discipline corridor varies by event and season.
spots.access_rules: Use the current nautical map and event/municipal closures.
spots.trip_value: The Défi events draw riders globally and the official destination frames Gruissan as an international benchmark; exceeds worth_trip.

spots.name: Almanarre
spots.identity: The Almanarre launch channel on the Giens tombolo at Hyères.
spots.conditions: Mistral-exposed Mediterranean venue with flat and wave states across the tombolo; strong-wind competence required.
spots.access_rules: Kites launch only through official channels and current seasonal rules.
spots.trip_value: Long-established international competition and training reputation exceeds worth_trip.

spots.name: Leucate – La Franqui
spots.identity: La Franqui/Coussoules wind-sport system; cliff beach and kite zone are distinct.
spots.conditions: Very strong offshore Tramontane can exceed 100 km/h; discipline-specific sections differ.
spots.access_rules: Kiting is prohibited at the cliff section and must use mapped sectors beyond it.
spots.trip_value: Official sources call it a kitesurf mecca and an internationally recognised event venue; world_class.

spots.name: Pantín
spots.identity: Pantín's Atlantic competition beach in Valdoviño.
spots.conditions: Consistent winds and strong Atlantic swell with changing beachbreak peaks.
spots.access_rules: Competition and bathing management apply; retain current and skill warnings.
spots.trip_value: Long-running world-circuit status and international reputation exceed worth_trip.

spots.name: Patos
spots.identity: Patos beach and the Pico de Patos wave near Nigrán.
spots.conditions: Atlantic beach and reef peaks with level-dependent hazards; exact take-off identity must be separated.
spots.access_rules: Attach current bathing zones, parking and reef/level guidance.
spots.trip_value: One of southern Galicia's best-known waves and a strong coastal trip setting support worth_trip after correction.

spots.name: Somo
spots.identity: Somo-Loredo's open-sea beachbreak, with access chosen outside supervised bathing.
spots.conditions: Long exposed beach with frequent waves and multiple shifting peaks.
spots.access_rules: High seasonal occupancy requires bathing-zone separation and local school guidance.
spots.trip_value: Cantabrian surf heritage, dense schools and long beach support worth_trip without clear world_class proof.

spots.name: Salinas
spots.identity: Salinas-San Juan's long Atlantic beach in Castrillón.
spots.conditions: Three-kilometre exposed beach with moderate-to-strong swell and multiple banks.
spots.access_rules: Use supervised areas and current local hazard information.
spots.trip_value: Long surf beach, services and established practice area support worth_trip.

spots.name: Trabucador
spots.identity: The narrow Trabucador sandbar in the Ebro Delta, with sea and bay sides kept distinct.
spots.conditions: Shallow bay and exposed sea sides provide different conditions; storm erosion and habitat sensitivity are material.
spots.access_rules: Vehicle, parking, night-access and nesting restrictions apply; exact sport corridor must be mapped.
spots.trip_value: Unusual two-sided delta geography and established wind-sport use support worth_trip after conservation correction.

spots.name: Castelldefels – La Pineda
spots.identity: The regulated La Pineda summer kitesurf zone at Castelldefels.
spots.conditions: Thermal sea breeze and wide sand support riding, but summer beach density is high.
spots.access_rules: Licence/bib, designated zone and current seasonal hours are mandatory.
spots.trip_value: Defined metropolitan access and official seasonal infrastructure support worth_trip after current rules are embedded.

spots.name: El Palmar
spots.identity: El Palmar's long Atlantic beachbreak at Vejer de la Frontera.
spots.conditions: Windy exposed beach with moderate-to-strong surf, shifting peaks and steep-shore sections.
spots.access_rules: Respect bathing zones and local flags; currents and shorebreak require level judgement.
spots.trip_value: Andalusian surf reputation, long beach and trip infrastructure support worth_trip.

spots.name: Mar Menor – La Mota
spots.identity: Proposed La Mota launch at San Pedro del Pinatar on the Mar Menor.
spots.conditions: Shallow lagoon setting is plausible for training, but current conditions and legal launch proof are weak.
spots.access_rules: Protected salt-flat and bathing constraints require an authority map.
spots.trip_value: Do not count until current official sport permission, exact zone and independent trip value are documented.

spots.name: Cape Drepano
spots.identity: The lighthouse-side wind-sport beach at Cape Drepano near Patras.
spots.conditions: Strong wind with flat-water and wave sections; local rescue and level matching are important.
spots.access_rules: Use established school/rescue access and keep clear of the lighthouse/reef hazards.
spots.trip_value: Distinctive cape geometry, year-round use and established services support worth_trip.

spots.name: Raches Lighthouse
spots.identity: The lighthouse wind-sport launch at Raches in Phthiotis.
spots.conditions: Stable wind with flat and wave sections separated by the point.
spots.access_rules: Exact public launch, rescue coverage and seasonal operating rules require confirmation.
spots.trip_value: Recognised Mediterranean wind venue with visitor infrastructure supports worth_trip after launch correction.

spots.name: Vassiliki
spots.identity: Vassiliki Bay's established windsurf zones on southern Lefkada.
spots.conditions: Strong afternoon thermal accelerates into the bay; crowded high-season water requires zone discipline.
spots.access_rules: Use school and current local zones; distinguish beginner mornings from strong afternoon wind.
spots.trip_value: Official sources rank it among the Mediterranean/world's best and report hundreds of daily riders; world_class.

spots.name: Nea Kios
spots.identity: Proposed wind-sport teaching coast at Nea Kios near Nafplio.
spots.conditions: Seasonal teaching conditions are documented by operators, but exact public zone and hazards are not.
spots.access_rules: Attach a municipal launch, season, rescue and bathing separation before publication.
spots.trip_value: Nafplio access and established instruction may support worth_trip, but only after identity/rule correction.

spots.name: Ai Giannis, Lefkada
spots.identity: Ai Giannis beach on Lefkada's northwestern coast.
spots.conditions: Afternoon wind and wave potential; exact kite and windsurf sections must be separated.
spots.access_rules: Use current training-centre zones and preserve swimmer separation.
spots.trip_value: Island setting, reliable wind-sport use and training infrastructure support worth_trip after zone correction.

spots.name: Prasonisi
spots.identity: Prasonisi's two-sided sandbar wind-sport destination at southern Rhodes.
spots.conditions: Flat and wave sides, strong wind and seasonal sandbar geometry create advanced as well as teaching conditions.
spots.access_rules: Keep discipline/level zones and seasonal access current.
spots.trip_value: Official destination sources describe a globally leading venue with dedicated accommodation and schools; world_class.

spots.name: Karpathos – Afiartis
spots.identity: The Afiartis/Makrys Gialos windsurf area near Karpathos airport.
spots.conditions: Exceptionally strong reliable Meltemi with distinct bay sections and skill levels.
spots.access_rules: Separate Makrys Gialos and stronger-water sectors; follow school/rescue guidance.
spots.trip_value: Internationally recognised exceptional wind reliability and specialist infrastructure place it above worth_trip.
